title: 8 Things a Godly Man Does the Morning After He Fails Again
caption:
8 things a godly man does the morning after he fails again.

Falling doesn't end you. Hiding does. Get up, say it plain, tell a brother, and take the next small step. God finishes what He starts.

Save this for the morning you need it.

#faith #godlymen #christianman #grace #sin #manofgod
